title: The Palms | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Gulf front Seagrove condo 65 footsteps to the private beach access, with community pool access and sleeping for 7
description_expanded: The Palms Designer Gulf Front Condo 65 footsteps to the Private Beach Access Home Introduction Unwind in comfort at The Palms , a renovated retreat in The Palms at Seagrove. With a community pool footsteps way, a private community beach access 65 footsteps from the condo, stylish and renovated interiors, and complimentary Taxi bikes, this designer condo is the perfect retreat for your family. Home Highlights Gulf views! Beach Access - 65 footsteps from the community beach access 2 Complimentary Bikes Outdoor Living - private Gulf-facing patio with high top dining and Adirondack seating Sleeping for 7 Guests - King Suite, Bunk Area, and a Queen Sleeper Sofa Renovated condo with updated baths and full kitchen Drip and kCop coffee makers Laundry Closet in unit Community parking for 2 vehicles on a first come, first serve basis Community Pool is 10 yards from the condo (pool not heated) Complete Clean Linen Program - All linens laundered after every stay Smart Home Security - keyless entry ensures the condo stays secure 1 st Floor Unit Location Perks 65 Footsteps to the Private Beach Access 7-minute bike ride to Seaside 2-Minute Walk to Seagrove Plaza dining, shopping, and events 1-Minute Walk to Prema Organic Café and Balance Yoga Studio Know Before You Go A mid-stay clean is required for bookings 10+ days (included in rate) Concierge available for add-ons like eBikes, beach bonfires, beach chair and umbrella setup, and chef services Pets are restricted Construction nearby - no refunds issued for noise or views during building
